scope: Open-source lead sourcing tools for a Tunisia-only B2B campaign
kind: Tool comparison; no prospect import, sending, installation or live provider test
recommendation: Start with Google Maps Scraper for discovery and Crawl4AI for website extraction; assess a small Tunisia batch before integration.

tools.name: Google Maps Scraper
tools.observed_text: Extract Google Maps business leads, emails, reviews, phone numbers, websites, ratings, coordinates
tools.role: Discover local businesses and published contact routes
unknowns: Tunisia-specific completeness and contact freshness not benchmarked

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.observed_text: CSS and XPath schemas: fast extraction with no LLM
tools.role: Extract company facts and contacts from supplied website or directory URLs
unknowns: Self-hosted library is not a general web-search API

tools.name: OpenEnrich
tools.observed_text: Free but network-dependent: proving one specific mailbox exists needs an SMTP conversation on port 25
tools.role: Optional email finding and checks after company discovery
unknowns: Mail-server checks may be inconclusive; inferred addresses are not published-contact evidence

tools.name: ScrapeGraphAI
tools.observed_text: Bring your own (OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, Azure, local via Ollama)
unknowns: Needs a local model or external model usage; managed API is separate and paid

tools.name: OpenGTM
tools.observed_text: Find companies by industry + region via Gemini + Google Search grounding
tools.role: Combined discovery, company research, scoring and draft preparation
unknowns: Gemini API required; documented message languages English and German need adaptation for current campaign
Publisher scoring signals are hypotheses, not confirmed buyer need or budget
